text:
Jules: EmeraldCare wants a temporary QPS lift and ap-southeast-1 enabled for their clinician demo next Wed. They also need an allowlist for CI runners + a small set of static IPs. Renewal check in 28 days, PM worried about friction. Need infra + networking signoff.

Hiro: Share tenant and current numbers?

Jules: tenant emeraldcare-prod-9. Baseline ~60 qps, asking up to 220 qps for a 36h window around the demo. Health: yellow; two onboarding blockers, slow docs.

Marta: Ok. CIDRs? Only outbound?

Jules: CIDRs: 198.51.100.128/26 (CI), 203.0.113.128/29 (on-prem relay). Only need outbound to our edges.

Hiro: Runbook snippet for ops team (for reference): `tenant=emeraldcare-prod-9 allowlist=[198.51.100.128/26,203.0.113.128/29] regions=+ap-southeast-1 qps_override=3x duration=36h`

Marta: I'll check pool-ded-5 (apac) capacity. If tight, we can schedule a burst node with tag emerald-burst. ETA ~1 hr.

InfraBot: job queued: allowlist-3625001111. Will report status.

Jules: Customer wants no throttles first 15 minutes of demo. Can we prioritize the window?

Hiro: We'll pre-warm and set fallback to eu-west-1 when latency >250ms or 5xx >0.75%. Enable extra logging for the demo.

Marta: Patching and rolling 20% -> 50% -> 100%. Monitoring hooks for latency and 5xx. Ping me on urgent.

InfraBot: allowlist-3625001111 started at 3625001200 status=in_progress

Jules: Marking renewal as watch; I'll collect demo feedback and NPS.

InfraBot: allowlist-3625001111 completed at 3625001399 status=success

Hiro: ap-southeast-1 routing live. Initial checks: 95th ~95ms, no errors. Burst node reserved but idle.

Cory: Sent checklist to EmeraldCare PM: add IPs, smoke test 30m prior, expect some cold-starts, report 5xx to #support.

Jules: PM confirmed 36h window approved. I'll follow up on renewal cadence after demo. Closing thread unless issues arise during the demo.
